title: Italian Electricity Market CfD Backtest
description: Reproducible preprocessing and historical backtest code for comparing market-only wind revenues with conventional, zonal-yardstick, and financial CfD settlements in Italy over 2015-2024.
notes: GME and Terna raw files are not redistributed in this software archive. A separate Zenodo data deposit can be built with scripts/build_zenodo_data_deposit.py; see data/source_manifest.csv for source and rights information.
